admission: Non-diagnostic strings exclude complete programs. Unique fragments: at most two nonempty lines and 160 UTF-8 bytes; unique entrypoint prefixes cannot contain their body. Larger fragments require two distinct problem owners. AST pieces are flattened strings, never holes/nonterminals.
admission_revision: Reject unique anonymous entrypoint arrows as well as named entrypoint-body fragments; retain full unused pool during deletion; add matched fixed-source AST control
cost: LTD1 dictionary plus LTV1 packets; all helpers/wrappers counted. 41 framing bytes/program; padding and dictionary IDs counted. Human metadata/duplicate readable views and shared decoder source reported separately.
search: Exact shortest segmentation chooses a complete verified alternative per problem. Enumerated initial dictionaries then bounded deletion trials; no claim of global optimality.
